headline: P&G plans to cut manufacturing and logistics workforce by up to 30% by 2030
summary: Procter & Gamble plans to reduce its manufacturing and logistics workforce by 20% to 30% by 2030 as part of a broader $10 billion productivity initiative. Driven by rising commodity inflation and slowing earnings growth, the consumer goods giant intends to heavily expand facility automation to boost efficiency. The planned supply chain cuts follow a previous restructuring effort that eliminated 7,000 office-based roles.

headline: Cisco cuts less than 1% of workforce in latest layoff round
summary: Cisco executed a targeted layoff round in November affecting less than 1% of its global workforce as part of an ongoing operational restructuring. The move follows larger job cuts earlier in the year aimed at reallocating resources toward strategic growth areas like artificial intelligence and improving revenue per employee. CEO Chuck Robbins expects these talent realignments to help the company generate $19 billion in incremental revenue while operating with a leaner headcount.

headline: MP scraps two-child rule for government employees
summary: The Madhya Pradesh government has repealed a 25-year-old rule that barred individuals with more than two children from state government jobs and penalized existing employees for having a third child. Citing declining fertility rates across the state and country, the government will also terminate ongoing disciplinary cases related to the policy. However, previously finalized penalties and orders issued under the former restriction will not be reopened.

headline: Karnataka GCCs employ 43% of India’s AI/ML workforce
summary: Karnataka has solidified its position as India's primary artificial intelligence hub, with its Global Capability Centres (GCCs) employing 43% of the country's GCC-based AI/ML workforce. Anchored by Bengaluru, the state accounts for 44% of senior AI leadership postings and attracted 43% of all new Indian GCC additions between FY21 and FY26. Furthermore, GCCs in the region are investing above the national average in dedicated AI training to build specialized capabilities.

headline: The career mistakes that don’t look like mistakes
summary: HR leaders highlight subtle career mistakes that initially appear to be sensible choices, such as prioritizing speed over thoroughness, prestige over skill development, and compliance over critical thinking. Long-term professional growth relies on foundational learning, rigorous execution, and actively understanding context rather than blindly following instructions.

headline: How employee ownership created thousands of millionaires at Anthropic
summary: Following its initial public offering, AI startup Anthropic created substantial employee wealth, with nearly 96 percent of its 5,300 staff members holding equity valued at over $1 million. The company's stock-based compensation strategy drove exceptionally low attrition while particularly rewarding early joiners over later senior hires. To further support staff, Anthropic departed from traditional IPO norms by allowing employees to sell shares immediately post-listing.

headline: Baskaran Balasubramanian is now executive director-HR technologies, Wells Fargo
summary: Baskaran Balasubramanian has been appointed as Executive Director of HR Technologies at Wells Fargo after previously serving as Chief Information Officer at Deutsche Bank. Bringing over two decades of technology leadership experience from organizations including Oracle and ADP, his transition reflects the growing strategic integration of digital platforms in human capital management.

headline: Nike signs long-term global partnership with Formula 1
summary: Nike and Formula 1 have announced a long-term global partnership starting with the 2027 racing season. Under the agreement, Nike will become F1's official apparel provider for staff, launch co-branded footwear and apparel collections, and support the all-female F1 Academy series. The collaboration aims to capitalize on F1's growing global popularity by delivering official merchandise, race-weekend fan experiences, and specialized performance gear.
